crossRefs.note: Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because Yahweh has looked at my affliction…
“Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength; excelling in dignity, and excelling in power.
Boiling over like water, you shall not excel; because you went up to your father’s bed, then defiled it. He went up to…
Moses gave to the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families.

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: “By the border of Ephraim, from the east side even to the west side, Reuben, one portion.
translations.bsb: Reuben will have one portion bordering the territory of Ephraim from east to west.
translations.kjv: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Reuben.
translations.asv: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even unto the west side, Reuben, one portion.
